messages:
nate-neteng: Heads-up: scheduling MTU tuning on leaf switches + rolling node reboots in eu-west4 and us-central1. Window: 2025-08-12 01:00-03:00 UTC. Cohorts: 4 nodes per region, staggered 15m. Goal: reduce fragmentation and p95 tail spikes. Pre-seed KV-cache 30m prior. No dedicated pool reboots planned.
clara-sre: +1. Proposed flow: 10m canary per region -> cohort drain -> reboot -> 10m post-check. Abort if packet loss >0.25% or p95 latency >20% from baseline.
jordan-runtime: Runtime changes: prefer local warm-fallback routing for the window, temporarily lower max_batch_size to 20, enable prefix-cache priming 15m before first drain. I'll roll flags 20m prior.
eta-support: I'll draft status page copy and targeted emails for enterprise contacts. Post at 00:30 UTC? Need the affected pool names.
nate-neteng: Affected pools: shared-eu-west4, shared-us-central. No pinned tenants in the affected racks per inventory. ETA: please post at 00:30.
clara-sre: Runbook snippet I'll follow:
```
# canary
kubectl cordon node-canary && kubectl drain node-canary --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --grace-period=60
sleep 600
curl -f http://probe.internal/ping || rollback
```
jordan-runtime: Cost estimate: token backfill ~0.9% for the 2h window due to cache cold starts. Tagging billing-team; if >1.5% abort and reschedule. I'll request a transient capacity reservation for 30m after each cohort.
ops-bot: calendar event created: mtu-tune-and-rolling-reboots (2025-08-12T01:00Z-2025-08-12T03:00Z). Reference: #INC001752469999. Pager rotations preserved.
clara-sre: I'll post canary metrics (packet loss, p95, queue depth) at 01:10. If clean, start first cohort at 01:20.
nate-neteng: Final checklist: pre-seed 00:30, runtime flags 00:40, canaries 01:00-01:10, cohort cadence 15m. Support to post and customer comms ready. Thanks all :thumbsup:
